svg.data-vd-steps: [[0, "The light-dependent reactions on the thylakoid membrane."], [1, "Light excites electrons in photosystem II."], [3.5, "Water is split to replace them: photolysis releases O\u2082 and H\u207a."], [6.5, "Electrons flow along the chain; H\u207a are pumped into the thylakoid."], [9.5, "Photosystem I re-excites the electrons..."], [11.5, "...which reduce NADP in the stroma."], [14, "H\u207a flow out through ATP synthase: ATP is made."]]
svg.title: The light-dependent reactions
svg.desc: On the thylakoid membrane, light excites electrons in photosystem II, replaced by photolysis of water releasing oxygen and protons; electrons pass along the electron transport chain pumping protons, are re-excited at photosystem I and reduce NADP; protons flow through ATP synthase making ATP.

g.data-info: Light excites electrons in chlorophyll; the excited electrons leave to the electron transport chain.
The lost electrons are replaced by splitting water: 2H₂O → 4H⁺ + 4e⁻ + O₂. Oxygen is the by-product.
Electrons pass along carriers in the thylakoid membrane, releasing energy used to pump H⁺ into the thylakoid space.
NADP + 2e⁻ + H⁺ → reduced NADP, in the stroma.
H⁺ flow back to the stroma through ATP synthase: chemiosmosis makes ATP.
